propositions: Authors need guidance to name risky runtime mechanisms and commit to concrete fast out-of-loop proof (local run or manual probe) before codifying correctness in slow delivery loops like CI/CD, IaC apply, or provisioning.
The packaged guide must identify this guidance as criterion T15, reference it in criterion-pins.json, and remain stack-agnostic without product-specific Terraform or Docker instructions.
Hand-authored docs must be updated from stale T1–T12 range and 32 criteria count to validated T1–T15 range and 44 criteria count, with registry.py module docstring aligned to match.
Cleanup guidance must explicitly limit throwaway experiment teardown to only resources created by that experiment.

The rebar explain plan CLI and public explain_guide library must render T15 guidance, proof forms, and scoped-cleanup constraints without breaking existing guidance rendering outside the new addition.
